text:
sara: heads-up: planned staging rollout 04:00 UTC touching API header-splitting, router buffer tweak, and console routing. propose pinning runtime and placing a hold until prewarm + quick canary.
ben: +1. previous run saw parse_overflow and KV evictions on shard-3 with large headers.
ben: logs: 
[staging-router] WARN parse_overflow id=shard-3
[staging-runtime] INFO kv_eviction count=28 reason=header_pressure

olivia: rollback triggers suggestion: 5xx >0.5% for 10m OR kv_eviction_rate >0.02 for 5m OR session.reset_rate doubles. p95 latency >600ms abort.
kai: i'll add temporary grafana panels for `router.parse_overflow` and `kv_eviction_rate` and an alert rule for eviction_rate > 0.01 for 5m.
sara: deploy-bot commands i'll run after we agree:
/deploy hold staging --reason "router-buffer-safety" --by sara --until 1764011400
/deploy prewarm staging --shard shard-3 --type cache --by sara

deploy-bot: scheduled release at 2024-11-06T04:00Z for staging. to place a hold run `/deploy hold staging`.
ben: quick smoke now with header ~4.0kb: 5xx=1.1% first pass, after small router tweak 0.3%.
kai: grafana link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/parse-check . panels set. i'll keep alerts on for 90m post-cutover.
sara: pin runtime -> v2.15.2 for window and placing hold now. will keep console split FF off in staging.
deploy-bot: hold placed by sara at 1764007805 (reason: router-buffer-safety)
olivia: lift criteria: 15m stable canary with 5xx <0.2% and kv_eviction_rate <0.008 and p50 <300ms. else rollback.
ben: prewarm started. running targeted cache warm on shard-3.
deploy-bot: prewarm accepted; ETA ~10m.
kai: smoke after prewarm: 5xx 0.12%, kv_eviction_rate 0.005. looks within thresholds.
sara: thanks — i'll monitor and unhold when we hit 15m stable. please post short updates only.
